title: Aircraft Regulated Garbage Services (Pick-Up & Disposal), Travis AFB CA
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR MOBILITY COMMAND.FA4427  60 CONS LGC
detail_text: Travis AFB CA has a requirement for Aircraft Regulated Garbage Services (Pick-Up & Disposal). This is for a potential 5-year contract. See Performance Work Statement (PWS) for a full detail of the requirement. The Request for Information (RFI) Sources Sought does not constitute a Request for Quote (RFQ) or a promise to issue a future RFQ. This sources Sought does not commit the Government to contract for any supply or service. Further, the Air Force is not currently seeking proposal and will not accept unsolicited proposals. Responders are advised the Government will not pay for any information or administrative cost incurred in response to this RFI. Not responding to the RFI, does not preclude participation in any further RFQ, if issued. Response must include : Business name and address Name of company representative and their business title Buriness size and Type of Small Business if applicable Cage Code Unique Entity ID Capability Statement Vendors who wish to respond to this should send responses to both rachel.gil@us.af.mil and clark.teninty.1@us.af.mil. via email no later than 11 May 2026 @ 12:00 pm Pacific Time.
